bold-flat-colour.name: Bold Flat Colour
bold-flat-colour.subject: Late night noodle shop opening in Malmö
bold-flat-colour.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Late night noodle shop opening in Malmö.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Bold Flat Colour
A vector illustration built from a few huge flat shapes in saturated inks, printed as a poster with perfect hard edges and tiny cut out details in cream. It looks like a designer drew it in a vector tool and sent it to a good printer.
Signature moves to keep:
- objects cropped by the edges at diagonals
- tiny scale patterns cut into the hero shapes
- dots and bowls as punctuation
- type overlapping the artwork
- ground colour reused for small info text

SUBJECT
Show Late night noodle shop opening in Malmö in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
Two or three oversized objects tilt diagonally across the page and run off the edges, leaving the type to sit across them in a stack. A few small round or bowl shapes scatter in the gaps. The bottom corner stays quiet for small info in a darker tint of the ground.

TYPOGRAPHY
Extra heavy blocky sans or grotesk in a single bright colour, stacked in two to three tight lines and allowed to overlap the illustration. Small info text in a darker tint of the background.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Slurp Season"
- second line: "Hand pulled noodles until 2 am"
- small details: "Open Thu to Sun, Möllevången 12"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #0E8A5A, #FF1B1B, #FFE800, #F0359A, #F7B4D0, #1B4FC4. One saturated ground, one dominant hero colour and one loud type colour, plus small pink and blue accents. For a brand, set the ground to their main colour and make the hero and type the two most contrasting colours available.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Perfectly flat colour with a barely visible paper grain, no gradients, no shadows.

AVOID
- gradients
- drop shadows
- stock icon style
- 3D sheen
- gibberish text
- thin timid type
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects
- showing the design as a mockup (a poster on a wall, a phone, a hand holding it): the artwork itself must fill the whole canvas edge to edge, flat and straight on

Do not search the web or look anything up: work only from this brief, so nothing from elsewhere leaks into the design.
Make the image now, in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format, without asking questions first.
(Brief written with OpenTempl, the free, open source design app at opentempl.org. The designer brings the picture back there to set and edit the words.)

halftone-duotone.name: Halftone Duotone
halftone-duotone.subject: Monthly night run club for beginners
halftone-duotone.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Monthly night run club for beginners.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Halftone Duotone
A photograph converted to a coarse halftone duotone, printed in two fluorescent inks on uncoated paper, with giant condensed type that overprints and multiplies against the picture. It looks like a riso or screen print, not a filter.
Signature moves to keep:
- photo as visible halftone dots
- type overprinting the face
- two clashing inks only
- text block top right in the second ink
- corner credits

SUBJECT
Show Monthly night run club for beginners in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
The photographic subject is cropped tight and large, centred or slightly off, with two or three lines of massive type running across the face and body, left aligned. A small paragraph of text sits in the top right corner and tiny credits in the corners.

TYPOGRAPHY
Heavy condensed or bold grotesk capitals in the second ink, giant, multiplying over the image, with small justified text paragraph in the same ink.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Run Slow"
- second line: "Friendly 5 km night loops with tea after"
- small details: "First Thursday each month, 19:00, Rålambshovsparken"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #F4EFE2, #3B49E8, #FF4B3F, #FF2D87, #D8F41C. Choose two high chroma inks that clash on purpose, such as blue and red or pink and lime. For a brand, take the main and accent colours as the two inks and set paper to a warm neutral.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Visible halftone dot screen, ink overlap colour, grain, slight blur from the press.

AVOID
- full colour photography
- smooth gradients
- drop shadows
- glossy finish
- lens flare
- gibberish text
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects

pixel-world.subject: Cozy farming video game launch
pixel-world.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Cozy farming video game launch.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Pixel World
A pixel art and voxel illustration: chunky cubes with flat three tone shading, dither patterns and dot matrix lettering, composed over a calm sky photograph or flat blue field. It has the precision of game art and the calm of a poster.
Signature moves to keep:
- voxel object with 3 tone cube shading
- dither gradient clouds
- dot matrix title made of circles
- tiny orange sparks
- calm photographic sky

SUBJECT
Show Cozy farming video game launch in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
One hero object, a flower or creature, rises from the lower centre in cubes with floating satellite pieces and tiny sparks, dot matrix title at the top, small body text lower corners. Lots of empty sky around.

TYPOGRAPHY
Dot matrix or pixel capitals in lime or white for the title, small serif or mono lines for details.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Turnip Valley"
- second line: "Plant, grow and wander in a sleepy village"
- small details: "Out 12 Sept on PC and Switch"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #8FB8D8, #EE8DB8, #9DBB4E, #F5E9EC, #F2A64A, #2A3A52. Sky blue ground with pink, green and cream voxels and one orange spark. For a brand, set the sky or field to the brand colour and the voxel hero to its complement.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Hard pixel edges, flat three tone shading per cube, dither gradients, no blur.

- plastic 3D sheen
- lens flare
- blurry pixels
- gibberish text

Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: a live music night with three bands at a small venue.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Folk Cutout Garden
A paper cut and gouache folk illustration where each motif looks cut with scissors from coloured paper and pasted on a dark ground, with little hand drawn cream details. Mirrored arrangements echo embroidery and quilts.
Signature moves to keep:
- mirrored plants and birds
- checkerboard or sunburst medallion
- sun face in the top band
- cream doves in corners
- each shape slightly irregular

SUBJECT
Show a live music night with three bands at a small venue in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
Mirror symmetric arrangement around a central star or checkerboard sunburst with plants rising from the bottom and animals on a top band. Dense but ordered: every motif has black breathing room. Leave a plain band at the top or bottom for the title.

TYPOGRAPHY
Hand drawn rounded capitals in cream, slightly uneven, as if cut from paper, with a small handwritten line beneath.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Three Bands, One Night"
- second line: "Doors 20:00, entry 100 kr"
- small details: "Fri 14 Nov, Kolingsborg, Stockholm"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #161412, #EFE3BC, #E6382B, #2E5FBF, #2FAE4A, #E8398D. Near black ground with cream, tomato red, cobalt, leaf green and magenta cutouts. For a brand, keep the black ground and recolour red and cobalt to the brand pair.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Cut paper edges with tiny irregularities, soft ink speckle and a risograph like grain on coloured shapes.

AVOID
- perfect vector smoothness
- gradients
- glossy 3D
- gibberish text
- random asymmetry
- generic floral clipart
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects
- showing the design as a mockup (a poster on a wall, a phone, a hand holding it): the artwork itself must fill the whole canvas edge to edge, flat and straight on

Do not search the web or look anything up: work only from this brief, so nothing from elsewhere leaks into the design.
Make the image now, in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format, without asking questions first.
(Brief written with OpenTempl, the free, open source design app at opentempl.org. The designer brings the picture back there to set and edit the words.)

inflatable-balloon.name: Inflatable Type
inflatable-balloon.subject: Bouncy castle rental for children's parties
inflatable-balloon.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Bouncy castle rental for children's parties.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Inflatable Type
A 3D rendered or photographed inflatable look: letters and creatures made of balloon skin or vinyl, with soft reflections, pinch points at the ends and a thin outline of contrast colour. Believable lighting and tiny imperfections.
Signature moves to keep:
- puffy balloon material with pinch points
- thick coloured sticker outline
- letters inside circles
- bright flat ground
- visible seams and wrinkles

SUBJECT
Show Bouncy castle rental for children's parties in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
One big inflatable subject fills most of the frame, cropped slightly, with a thick sticker outline in a contrasting colour. A cluster of text circles or dots sits upper left and details in the bottom band.

TYPOGRAPHY
Typewriter or round mono letters set inside yellow dots, or puffy 3D letters in the same material. Small justified serif details.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Hoppa Hela Sommaren"
- second line: "Castles, slides and balloon arches for your party"
- small details: "Book now at hoppa.example, 070 123 45 67"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #F6F6F8, #E64A2E, #5EC2F5, #FFE16A, #FF4FA3. White or pearly inflatable on a bright flat ground with a thick contrast outline. For a brand, use the brand colour as the ground and keep the balloon neutral, or invert them.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Rubber skin, subtle seams, finger smudges, soft studio reflections, a little dust.

AVOID
- perfectly plastic CGI gloss
- lens flare
- chrome unless asked
- gibberish text
- creepy faces
- dark moody lighting

stitch-type.name: Stitched Pixel Type
stitch-type.subject: Monday knitting circle at a community centre
stitch-type.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Monday knitting circle at a community centre.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Stitched Pixel Type
A woven or cross stitched textile pattern built from square stitches, with letters, flowers and ornament drawn on a pixel grid and photographed on fabric or laid over a photograph. Each square has thread texture.
Signature moves to keep:
- every letter built from square stitches
- checkerboard medallion
- border of repeating flowers
- thread fibres visible
- pixel grid alignment

SUBJECT
Show Monday knitting circle at a community centre in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
The pixel pattern fills the full sheet as a repeating border or checkerboard medallion, with a title woven as large blocky letters across the middle. Quiet cream rows surround the title for text.

TYPOGRAPHY
Pixel blocky capitals woven from stitches, uniform stroke, set on the grid with no smooth curves.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Stitch Night"
- second line: "Bring yarn, we bring tea"
- small details: "Mondays 18:00, Fruängens Bibliotek"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #EFE7D2, #7FB04A, #E9E34B, #E76F51, #1B1B1B, #3C5A9A. Cream or dark ground with two or three thread colours plus black. For a brand, thread the type in the brand colour and keep the pattern in complementary threads.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Visible thread twist on each stitch, soft fabric weave, light shadow between stitches.

AVOID
- smooth vector curves
- gradients
- glossy 3D
- photoreal flowers
- lens flare
- gibberish text
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers

Signature moves to keep:
- thick black outline on every item
- hard offset shadows
- grid backdrop
- hand pointing at the hero
- sticker tags like SOLD OUT

TYPOGRAPHY
Chunky outlined lettering in yellow or pink with a black outline and a hard offset shadow, small rounded caps labels on sticker tags.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Smash Friday"
- second line: "Double smash burgers, truck number 7"
- small details: "Every Fri 16 to 22, Brewhouse Yard"

Create a finished graphic design: a instagram post in 4:5 portrait format. It is for: an announcement post for a new product launch from a small shop.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Riso Two Ink
A risograph print in two fluorescent inks, red and blue, layered on uncoated paper. Images are rendered as coarse halftone and stipple, with areas where the inks overlap into deep purple.
Signature moves to keep:
- solid red shape cut into blue halftone image
- purple where inks overlap
- visible misregistration
- white paper margins with edition number in pencil
- coarse grain everywhere

SUBJECT
Show an announcement post for a new product launch from a small shop in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
One strong image fills most of the sheet inside a margin, with a bold shape such as a sun or arch in solid red cutting into it. Text sits small in the margin or large in red over the picture. White paper border shows on all sides.

TYPOGRAPHY
Bold condensed grotesk capitals in red, partly overprinting the image, with small typewriter or grotesk captions in blue.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Now In Store"
- second line: "The autumn collection is here"
- small details: "Open daily 10 to 18"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #F3EEE4, #2438B8, #F5412D, #5B2A86. Cream paper, one blue and one red ink, overlap makes purple. For a brand, choose two inks from the brand palette and describe the overlap as their mix.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Heavy grain, visible halftone, misregistration between inks, flecks of uneven coverage.

AVOID
- clean gradients
- extra colours beyond the two inks
- glossy finish
- photographic smoothness
- lens flare
- gibberish text
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects
- showing the design as a mockup (a poster on a wall, a phone, a hand holding it): the artwork itself must fill the whole canvas edge to edge, flat and straight on

Do not search the web or look anything up: work only from this brief, so nothing from elsewhere leaks into the design.
Make the image now, in 4:5 portrait format, without asking questions first.
(Brief written with OpenTempl, the free, open source design app at opentempl.org. The designer brings the picture back there to set and edit the words.)

oil-pastel-scribble.name: Oil Pastel Scribble
oil-pastel-scribble.subject: Sunday cardamom bun morning at a small bakery
oil-pastel-scribble.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Sunday cardamom bun morning at a small bakery.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Oil Pastel Scribble
A hand drawn oil pastel and crayon drawing scanned from white paper, with waxy strokes, visible paper tooth and a folded poster crease. Thin pencil and marker details sit on top of the thick colour.
Signature moves to keep:
- thick crayon fill with gaps
- wobbly drawn person and furniture
- tiny pencil detailed plants and cups
- fold creases across the poster
- catalogue style labels

SUBJECT
Show Sunday cardamom bun morning at a small bakery in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
One cosy object or scene fills the lower two thirds, drawn cheerfully off proportion, with a tiny shelf or plant above. The title block is huge and sits at the top. Lots of white paper remains around everything.

TYPOGRAPHY
Blocky crayon capitals with waxy texture for the title, and clean plain sans for small labels set as if from a catalogue.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Bun Day"
- second line: "Fresh from the oven, still warm"
- small details: "Sundays 8 to 12, Rosa's Bageri, Bergsgatan 9"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #FFFFFF, #E0242B, #1E9A3C, #E8A24A, #F0C0C8, #7A4B2A. White paper, a strong crayon red for the title, a hero green for the main object, small warm accents. For a brand, draw the hero object in the brand colour and keep the red crayon title in the brand accent.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Waxy grain, patchy coverage with white gaps, light fold creases and paper tooth.

- vector outlines
- gradients
- airbrush
- lens flare

blue-ink-doodle.name: Blue Ink Doodle
blue-ink-doodle.subject: Tuesday open mic comedy night at a cafe
blue-ink-doodle.prompt:
Create a finished graphic design: a poster in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format. It is for: Tuesday open mic comedy night at a cafe.
It must look designed and made by hand by a skilled human designer and illustrator, in the style described below. Treat the style as a strict art direction.

STYLE: Blue Ink Doodle
A dense scribbled pen and felt tip drawing in one blue ink on an off white sheet, scanned, with a huge neutral grotesk set in red over the top. The drawing is deliberately wonky and funny.
Signature moves to keep:
- monoline doodle crowd of creatures and objects
- scribble filled black shapes in blue
- speech bubbles with handwritten lines
- giant plain grotesk over the drawing
- tiny credit columns at the bottom

SUBJECT
Show Tuesday open mic comedy night at a cafe in this style. Make the subject the hero and fit everything to it: props, setting and details should belong to this subject, not to the example the style came from.

COMPOSITION
Doodles fill the page edge to edge in a loose crowd, with a few filled shapes for weight. Huge red type sits in the top and bottom bands and a large date or number block crosses the middle, all over the drawing but readable.

TYPOGRAPHY
Large neutral Swiss grotesk in warm red, tight leading, mixed case, the biggest element on the page, with a tiny grid of small credits at the bottom.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Open Mic"
- second line: "Every Tuesday"
- small details: "Doors 19:00, Café Orbit, Drottninggatan 21"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #F2EFE8, #1F4FAE, #D9503C, #1A1A1A. Off white paper, a single blue for all the drawing and one warm red for the type. For a brand, use the brand main colour for the pen drawing and a contrasting accent for the type.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Biro and felt tip strokes with ink pooling, slight paper grain, no digital polish.

AVOID
- clean vector icons
- gradients
- colourful rainbow palette
- airbrush
- lens flare
- gibberish text
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects
- showing the design as a mockup (a poster on a wall, a phone, a hand holding it): the artwork itself must fill the whole canvas edge to edge, flat and straight on

neon-glow.prompt:

- bloom haze
- tiny caption paragraph
- deep black ground

A cluster of tube logos and glyphs fills the middle, with generous black space, a small caption paragraph beneath, and numbers in a bottom row. A dot grid or scan lines optionally in the background.

TYPOGRAPHY
Monoline wide capitals made of tubes or LED dots, with tiny spaced caption text in pale blue below.
Render exactly these words, spelled exactly as written, and no other text anywhere:
- headline: "Cafe Menu"
- second line: "Coffee, pastries and lunch"
- small details: "Filter coffee 35 kr, Cinnamon bun 40 kr, Soup of the day 120 kr"
Give them a clear hierarchy: the headline large and dominant, the rest much smaller.

COLOUR
Palette: #02030A, #2D8CFF, #9FD4FF, #F5FBFF, #1A3FA0. Black with one cold neon colour in two intensities and a white hot core. For a brand, use the brand colour for the tubes and keep the white core.

TEXTURE AND FINISH
Bloom and haze around bright lines, soft glow reflection, fine scan line texture.

AVOID
- multicolour rainbow neon
- lens flare streaks
- brushed metal
- gibberish text
- chrome
- clip art neon signs
- anything that looks AI generated: plastic sheen, airbrushed skin, overly smooth gradients, glow and lens flare, HDR, stock photo smiles
- gibberish letters, made up words or any text other than the exact words given
- watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders or frames around the design
- filler decoration: sparkles, floating dots and stars, confetti, random geometric shapes, gradient orbs, ornamental dividers
- uniform line weight, plastic or airbrushed shading, soft storybook gloss, perfect symmetry, melted or merging details, impossible objects
- showing the design as a mockup (a poster on a wall, a phone, a hand holding it): the artwork itself must fill the whole canvas edge to edge, flat and straight on

Do not search the web or look anything up: work only from this brief, so nothing from elsewhere leaks into the design.
Make the image now, in A3 portrait (1:1.41) format, without asking questions first.
(Brief written with OpenTempl, the free, open source design app at opentempl.org. The designer brings the picture back there to set and edit the words.)
